lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six vertical columns of high-intensity circular spot clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the largest and highest-luminance centroids located in the mid-lateral flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of white spots, creating a grid-like arrangement across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin; irregular pale markings or possible surface abrasions visible near the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense pattern of small, high-contrast spots is present on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, decreasing in diameter toward the distal tip.
